scope: Material-export revision of the existing candidate inspection only; original detailed source and oldGLB immutable. No geometry/tread/sidewall/bead change, no new supplier/marking.
reason: Native original3D Noise+Bump and roughness ramp are absent from legacyconstant GLB.
geometry_preservation: Append the exact named inspection object from oldsource; retain positions/topology/smooth normals/UV0/world matrix. Compare actual old/newGLB triangle corner POSITION/NORMAL/UV0, matrix; new tangent data is explicitly new, not claimed oldT preservation. No postexport buffer repair.
material_transfer: Bake actual existing donor original rubber material on the same inspection geometry and unchanged UV0. Normal tangent +X,+Y,+Z includes originalBump strength and distance; final normalStrength1 avoids a second attenuation. Roughness linear via temporary emission of original ramp, then pack ORM R255/Groughness/B0. Retain constant linear baseColor and IOR from actualnative donor.

Actual sourcecoords and UVs, no fictitious physical dimensions.
